description:
The next-generation user interface for all non-automotive USB PC Oscilloscopes, including all the analysis tools you need to get answers quickly, whether carrying out a simple test, or debugging a complex design.


New features:
- Adding Notes will now automatically bring the caret into the Notes viewport.

Bug fixes:
- Fixed an issue where it would sometimes not be possible to uninstall an Arm64 version of the PicoScope 7 software.
- Fixed an issue that prevented the progress indicators from being displayed while capturing with Rapid Trigger.
- Resolved issue where data would be lost if a Rapid Trigger capture was stopped mid-capture.
- Improvements to lock-to-axis behavour for touch controls when pinch zooming.
- General stability improvements.
- Fixed a bug resulting in a timeout error on resolution change for PSOSPA MSO PicoScopes.
